items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Nick Castle as the choreographer for 'Jump for Joy', but the interviewee (Paul L. Howard) does not respond with any personal interaction, memory, or confirmation of working with him.

ctx.x: Well, there was Nick Castle, who had -- he was formerly with Paramount Studios and Columbia different Studios, but mostly with Paramount.
So you worked with the Ellington band and who all else was in that --
